# Grok Bot Galaxy — llms.txt
# Unofficial Day 1 notes (clips 01–18). Maintainer: etor6233.
# Agents: read this file first, then knowledge/INDEX.md. Do not invent.

## Product
Grok Bot = persistent named teammates in a chat UI (iMessage-like), not a new chat per task.
Three decisions: (1) teammate paradigm (2) each bot has an isolated Linux VM computer (3) everything runs in the cloud 24/7.
Maturity curve: Ask/Chatbots → Do a task/Copilots → Delegate outcome/Bot → Staff function/Team of Bots.

## 101 demo (Amrita) — Data Dan + Slide Sonya + Email Ethan
Create: sidebar + → name (job inferred from name) → chips → type or voice a task.
Computer: top-right; isolated per bot; drives Google Forms/Slides/etc. without MCP.
Teach a task: you drive the VM → Stop → becomes a Private skill.
Auto-review: Settings → General; Ask first wins; Allow once / Deny on cards.
A2A: mention another bot, or Chief of Staff “always delegate”; group chat = visibility.
Manager bot: routine e.g. every 2h collect blockers.
Share as template (header). Duplicate = same persona, empty memory.
Marketplace: public featured (Lauren Tan dr eggbot, Lenny Overheard, Claire Vo Tradbot, Eric Zakariasson Projects Manager) + team plugins.
Secrets/1Password: modal in Grok Bot, not typed on the VM; stored in product, not shown to SpaceX.
Memory: S3, long-lived, steerable; you can tell a bot to forget / stop delegating.

## Integrations named on stage
Hex, Gmail, LinkedIn, Salesforce, Sumble, Google Sheet/Drive/Docs/Forms/Slides, Qualtrics, Slack, Notion, X MCP, p-stack, Vercel, figma-mcp, Databricks, 1Password, Stripe/Link card on a bot.
